mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, tenant_code, display_name, initial_administrator_subject_id, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.tenant_lifecycle WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_outbox (event_id, tenant_id, event_type, lifecycle_status, lifecycle_version, occurred_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{tenantId}, 'TENANT_LIFECYCLE_CHANGED', #{status}, #{version}, #{occurredAt})
